reviews_h2: Straight from the people who called us

reviews.author: Isobel Houston
reviews.text: I would highly recommend MJ Landscaping and Design! I called him for an estimate and had no idea what I even wanted to get done- he came to look at the project and had great ideas and was able to complete the work quickly and was very reasonably priced. We’ve received several compliments already from neighbors. Very professional and great to work with. We will be using him for our future landscaping needs. Thanks again!

reviews.author: Jeremy Pullen
reviews.text: Mike is very dependable, hard working, and through. The yard looks great after every visit. I will and have recommended him to my friends and family.

reviews.author: Shadon Tonge
reviews.text: I contacted MJ for a project in my yard. His customer service was excellent and he was prompt to our appointment. I was thoroughly impressed with his work and ability to see my vision. I highly recommend MJ Landscaping and Design.

reviews.author: E Tee
reviews.text: MJ Landscaping and Design is absolutely amazing! The owner is so kind, pleasant and professional! He loves what he does and it shows!!! I couldn’t be more overjoyed at the results of the work. Do not hesitate to use this company. As a real estate agent, I would absolutely refer any of my clients for the services that they provide without hesitation!

reviews.author: Michelle O'Quinn
reviews.text: I highly recommend MJ landscaping and design! He has come to my rescue a couple times now and I won’t be calling anyone else to do my lawn. He is quick, professional, courteous, trustworthy and just a kind human!

reviews.author: Jeff Johnston
reviews.text: Mike and (his crew) did an outstanding job of bringing a vision we had for a yard to fruition! I highly recommend MJ Landscaping. It was a big project and he completed it better than expected! I would highly recommend MJ Landscaping and Design to anyone!

reviews.author: Melanie Rachel
reviews.text: Mike is great. He is a hard worker. He cleared up the yard and helped up haul debris away. He is very polite and professional. Definitely recommend his service.

reviews.author: Dana D
reviews.text: On time, reasonable prices, fast and thorough. He was accessible for planning and willing to assist with design and materials. He came to work, no nonsense. I appreciate his professionalism and honesty!

reviews.author: Gregory Swift
reviews.text: I called MJ Landscaping and got their voicemail so I Ieft a message and was called back within 6 mins. But I had already walked into a retirement luncheon and couldn't answer. I called back when I could, no answer. Throughout the day I called back 3 more times and no answer each time. So after calling them back 4 times, I said to heck with it, find someone else

reviews.author: A Murphy
reviews.text: I have had my yard done many of times . But when I call MR Jones …. He was on time … stayed late .I will definitely be calling and referral him to others

reviews.author: Leondra Hamlin
reviews.text: Mike is always so dependable and goes over and beyond to make sure he provides the best service for every customer he comes in contact with. He’s highly recommend.

reviews.author: Nicole Tripp
reviews.text: I am very pleased with my backyard landscaping. They were timely, professional and did an outstanding job!
